SwarmerBadge.png|'''Swarmer''' on the Spring 2020 [[Badges|badge]]. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The old store icon for the '''Swarmer''' has it outfitted in its Level 5 appearance (except for the Bee Gun, replaced with honey). *The '''Swarmer's''' version 1-3 Level 5 outfit is very similar to R2DA's [[w:c:r2da:Beekeeper Suit|Beekeeper Suit]]. *The '''Swarmer's''' Level 3+ weapon, is heavily based on the [https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Bee_Gun Bee Gun] from ''Terraria''. The ''Beehive Grenade'' is also based on a ''Terraria'' item, the [https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Beenade Beenade]. *Prior to the 30th of April 2025, its ability would be referred to as ''Beehive Grenade''. This would be an incorrect name as the '''Swarmer''' actually throws a bee nest. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The bees that the '''Swarmer''' fires at the enemies are the {{RLinkC|49048703|Bees}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The hat formerly used by the Level 5 '''Swarmer''' is the {{RLinkC|14082293|Beekeeper}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. **This hat is also used by the Level 1-4 '''Swarmer''' in a different texture. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Swarmer]]. Check the main article for statistical changes.'' *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] ** '''Swarmer''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Default Level 0-5 appearance changed. *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **Default Level 0-5 appearance changed. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **Updated explosion visual effects. *'''30 April 2025''' - [[v1.63.0]] **All skins' Level 0-5 appearance changed. **Stinging visuals updated. **Stinging now plays a sound. **{{Bug}} Fireworks from the [[Firework Technician]] are invisible. **{{Bug}} '''Swarmer''' does not stop moving when frozen by both legacy and modern freeze from enemies. **{{Bug}} '''Swarmer's''' frozen body does not have animations. **{{Bug}} Stun visuals do not appear above '''Swarmer's''' head. **{{Bug}} Tower pet has no animations. **{{Bug}} [[Medic]] ''Cleansing'' ability effects do not appear on the '''Swarmer'''. **{{Bug}} '''Swarmer's''' face is mostly black on mobile. *'''18 June 2025''' - [[v1.67.0|v1.67.6]] **{{Bugfix}} Stun visuals now appear above the '''Swarmer's''' head. **{{Bugfix}} Fireworks from the [[Firework Technician]] generated by the '''Swarmer''' are no longer invisible. *'''11 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.3]] **{{Bug}} '''Swarmer's''' ''Bee Swarm Grenade'' ability model remains permanently stuck on the path even after use. *'''12 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Swarmer's''' ''Bee Swarm Grenade'' ability model no longer remains permanently stuck on the path even after use. {{TowerNavBox}} {{ShadowTOC}}
